notes: No street intersections on this sheet. The only street is Dodsworth Av. (printed DODSWORTH AV.), which enters from the west on the Mill Creek bridge (approach centre y~3705), turns SSE, crosses the B.&O.S.W. R.R. at grade (~1990,5200) and leaves at the bottom toward sheet 606; house numbers run continuously 3806 at the bridge to 3718 at the bottom edge. The circled (56') on the bridge is not a width; the bridge approach is ~33 ft between its lines. The rest of the sheet is the Clifton Springs Distilling Co. grounds, the B.&O.S.W. tracks, the Miami Canal and open land east of the canal; 'PASS OVER R.R. TRACKS' is a footbridge, not a street.
